name: Runemaster Wind Walker shortens Rune cooldowns every 5 sec only while Runic Tattoos: Air is active (#3670)
contract: Wind Walker 807376 reads 'While Runic Tattoos: Air is active, the remaining cooldown of Rune spells is reduced by
$807529s1% every $t1 sec.' Its three native SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL effects (amplitude 5000 ms) trigger
807746, 807529 and 807991, whose effects are the Ascension effect 192 (reduce the remaining cooldown of spell
MiscValue by the effect value %). 807529 names Ice Rune 524930, Guarding Rune 500464 and Speed Rune 801103 at
EffectBasePoints 4 + DieSides 1 = 5%. Effect 192 is EffectNULL unless spell_ascension_the_bieko_effect is bound, and
no binding existed, so the talent did nothing. Expected: with its own Runic Tattoos: Air 802630 active, a Guarding
Rune (RecoveryTime 120000 ms) cooldown loses 5% of its remaining time on each tick; three or four ticks fall in a
16 s window, which removes roughly 14 to 20 s beyond elapsed time. Without the Air tattoo the talent does nothing.
A control Runemaster without the talent starts the same cooldown at the same moment, so the relative difference
isolates the talent. Fails before the fix (difference near zero); passes after.
